text.p: Novavax Inc said Tuesday its chief executive Richard Maradie will assume the additional position of president, replacing Denis O'Donnell, who has resigned the post.
O'Donnell will remain with the company as a senior advisor.

The company said the transition of responsibilities was planned and will not affect the nature or timing of the company's various product development and clinical programs for novel dosage forms of a variety of drugs.

Novavax said it has three product candidates in human clinical testing and expects preliminary efficacy data on one of them later this year, with results on the two others following "shortly thereafter".
Novavax Inc is a bio-pharmaceutical drug delivery company.
